Bachelor's degree or higher (University/FH) in Speech and Language Therapy, Audiology, Speech and Hearing Sciences, Special Education, or a related field

Excellent written and spoken English skills; additional language skills are an advantage

Strong communication and intercultural skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in international teams
